name: SIUT
mission: Established in 2000, SIUT North America is a charitable organization under Section 501(c)(3). It is dedicated to health-related humanitarian causes, with its major focus on helping Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT) Pakistan secure vital medical funds so all patients are treated free of charge and without discrimination.

rich_narrative.summary: SIUT North America Inc serves as a vital funding arm for the Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT) in Karachi, Pakistan. The organization focuses on providing <cite id="1">specialized medical equipment and medicine</cite> to support free healthcare for patients suffering from end-stage renal disease and other critical conditions. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="2">$5,921,512 in total revenue</cite>, maintaining a steady growth trajectory with a <cite id="3">3-year revenue CAGR of 14.9%</cite>. The organization is highly efficient, directing a <cite id="4">84.0% program expense ratio</cite> toward its mission according to recent filings, though third-party ratings like Charity Navigator calculate a <cite id="5">84.0% program ratio</cite> based on their specific accounting adjustments. This funding facilitates complex procedures including <cite id="6">dialysis, kidney transplants, and cancer treatment</cite> for underserved populations. While the charity demonstrates strong financial health with <cite id="7">4.0 months of working capital</cite>, its impact is concentrated on a single medical trust, which creates a geographic dependency. The charity holds a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid, reflecting a commitment to public disclosure. For Muslim donors, the organization provides a <cite id="8">verified zakat-eligible pathway</cite> to support the poor and needy (fuqara and masakin) requiring life-saving medical intervention.
